title: Modern 1BR Near BNA Airport & Downtown Nashville
description:
Welcome to your modern Nashville retreat! This stylish 1BR/1BA apartment offers the perfect blend of comfort and convenience just 5 minutes from Nashville International Airport (BNA) and 10 minutes from Downtown Nashville. Ideal for couples, solo travelers, business guests, or small groups, the apartment features a queen bedroom, sofa sleeper, fully equipped kitchen, fast WiFi, and self check-in.

Welcome to your comfortable Nashville home base—perfectly located for exploring the city while enjoying a relaxing stay.

Relax in the inviting living room featuring stylish furnishings, comfortable seating, Smart TV, and high-speed WiFi. Whether you're catching up on work or unwinding after a day exploring Nashville, this space is designed for comfort.

The fully equipped kitchen includes:

Modern appliances

Ample counter space

Full bathroom
